python3 << 'EOF'
# Export-Import Bank Total Direct Sales 1963-1974 (millions of dollars)
values = [366, 436, 124, 63, 153, 91, 379, 406, 269, 248, 145, 21]

# Sort to find median
sorted_values = sorted(values)
print("Sorted values:", sorted_values)

# Calculate median (12 values, so average of 6th and 7th)
median = (sorted_values[5] + sorted_values[6]) / 2
print(f"Median: ({sorted_values[5]} + {sorted_values[6]}) / 2 = {median}")

# FY 1974 value
fy_1974 = 21

# Signed deviation: 1974 value - median
deviation = fy_1974 - median
print(f"Signed deviation: {fy_1974} - {median} = {deviation}")

# Round to one decimal place
rounded = round(deviation, 1)
print(f"Rounded to one decimal place: {rounded}")
EOF
